turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Here is a worked example before your exercise.
"My brother has ___ idea." The word after the gap is "idea". It starts with the sound "i", which is a vowel sound, so I pick an: My brother has an idea.
Rule: choose an before a vowel sound and a before a consonant sound.
Right: My brother has a bike.
Wrong: My brother has an bike.

Now you. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
